title: Algebraic Schouten Solitons Associated to Perturbed Canonical Connection and Perturbed Kobayashi-Nomizu Connection on Three-Dimensional Lorentzian Lie Groups
content: In this paper, we study algebraic Schouten solitons concerning the perturbed canonical connection and the perturbed Kobayashi Nomizu connection on three-dimensional Lorentzian Lie groups and give the complete classification of the algebraic Schouten solitons with product structure on three-dimensional Lorentzian Lie groups.
